name: battle_gato_front
doc: GATO's exhibit by the reference's way: after Marle joins, the party leaves the fair to the 1000 A.D. overworld (as forest_entry) and comes back in (loc 005 from the south, up the north stairs to loc 1B7, the plaza), then gato_front's walk west into loc 006 and up to GATO. The detour matters to the battle bakes: the overworld leaves its sparkle in OBJ tiles 0x05/0x15 (the naming screen had cleared them) and the plaza's NPCs leave the OBJ palettes the GATO captures have (gato_press_action.state: E4 B2/8B/10/A1 in slots 0/2/3/4; here 8B/10/A1 sit in slots 3/4/2 -- the order they were claimed, which this walk does not reproduce); Crono stands at (134,164) facing GATO and Marle at (137,164) as there (a step right and back: the follower closes to 3 px).
